# Hand-written PTX emitters — the A2 freeze. Generated by scripts/hand-ptx-freeze.sh
# Regenerate with: scripts/hand-ptx-freeze.sh --write-manifest
#
# Every file below writes PTX text into a string by hand. CI refuses a file
# that joins this list: new kernels are built on KernelIR (kernel_ir.rs ->
# backend_ptx.rs). backend_ptx.rs is the one member that belongs here by
# construction — it is the PTX printer KIR lowers through. Everything else
# is hand-PTX, including the shared preludes in kernel_skeleton/ that the
# hand-written kernels compose. The list is meant to shrink.
